title: Grid Generation and D&D
summary: This module generates grids of model responses by steering along persona vectors, supporting both 3x3 and 2x2 configurations. It also provides utilities for analyzing and selecting the 'best' cells from these generated grids.

nodes.label: Generate Response Grids
nodes.title: Generate Response Grids
nodes.description: Orchestrates the generation of model responses across a grid of sycophancy and chaos steering values. Supports 3x3 and 2x2 grids, with optional trait and coherence judging.

nodes.label: Register Steering Hook
nodes.title: Register Steering Hook
nodes.description: Registers a forward hook on a model layer to apply a steering vector with a given alpha value, enabling persona steering.

nodes.label: Execute Model Generation
nodes.title: Execute Model Generation
nodes.description: Runs the model's text generation process after applying steering hooks, then removes the hooks to clean up.

nodes.label: Extract Corner Alphas
nodes.title: Extract Corner Alphas
nodes.description: Retrieves the alpha values for the 'best' cell within a specified corner of a D&D playground grid.

nodes.label: Get Best Cell
nodes.title: Get Best Cell
nodes.description: Identifies and returns the 'best' cell from a given D&D playground corner, typically based on evaluation metrics.

nodes.label: Steering Mechanisms
nodes.title: Steering Mechanisms
nodes.description: Handles the core logic for applying persona steering vectors to the model's activations.

nodes.label: Vector Composition Tools
nodes.title: Vector Composition Tools
nodes.description: Provides utilities for combining and calibrating persona vectors, used in multi-axis steering.

nodes.label: Persona Evaluation
nodes.title: Persona Evaluation and Testing
nodes.description: Contains tools and scripts for validating, evaluating, and testing persona steering effectiveness and coherence.

groups.label: Grid Generation
groups.title: Grid Generation
groups.description: Components responsible for generating model responses across a grid of steering parameters.

groups.label: D&D Playground Analysis
groups.title: D&D Playground Analysis
groups.description: Utilities for analyzing and extracting key information from D&D playground results.
